About

An image archive
built around collections.

This is a personal working archive: film stills, campaigns, editorials, portraits, events, posters and historical photographs gathered for visual research.

Images stay grouped by their original context. Dates, subjects and credits are recorded where known; uncertain details remain marked as such rather than guessed.
